title: Bungo Stray Dogs 4
native: 文豪ストレイドッグス 第4シーズン
synopsis:
No longer concerned with military affairs, Yukichi Fukuzawa intends to act as a lone bodyguard-for-hire, making use of his deadly swordsmanship. However, things are not going as planned for his freelance business, and that is when he crosses paths with a mouthy boy named Ranpo Edogawa. While their initial interactions are intertwined with a bizarre murder mystery, the aftermath prompts the formation of the Armed Detective Agency.

Presently, Ranpo finds himself chasing down a gifted individual with the dangerous ability to execute the perfect crime. But as the great detective unravels the case, he soon discovers an elaborate plot to obliterate the Agency in its entirety.

Although forewarned of the trap, the Agency continue their pursuit of the criminals, only to end up framed for the crime themselves. Now branded as wanted terrorists, the remaining members must find a way to prove their innocence—even if they must turn to sworn enemies for assistance.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

episodes.title: The Lone Swordsman and the Famous Detective
episodes.synopsis:
Security police officer Fukuzawa Yukichi arrives at work to discover that his client had been assassinated. The assassin is already apprehended by the time he arrives, but something doesn’t quite seem right.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Day Is a Dream, The Night Is Real
episodes.synopsis:
Fukuzawa gives Rampo a pair of glasses, claiming that wearing them would activate his ability to instantly determine the truth of any situation, and taking them off would give him the ability to tolerate the stupidity of the ordinary person.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Secret Founding of the Detective Agency
episodes.synopsis:
Rampo gets a ride to the police station, but the officer doesn’t seem to be who he says he is.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: A Perfect Murder and Murderer (Part 1)
episodes.synopsis:
Kunikida is being held for a murder that Rampo is certain he didn't commit. Meanwhile, Poe is determined to solve a murder mystery that has had the poilce stumped. Rampo has some thoughts on that situation, too.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: A Perfect Murder and Murderer (Part 2)
episodes.synopsis:
The last page of the manuscript received by Poe appears to have been a photocopy. Rampo seems to know why, but there are still more mysteries surrounding the death of the author.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Tragic Sunday
episodes.synopsis:
The Detective Agency receives an urgent request from the government to investigate a series murders perpetrated by the same culprit.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Dogs Hunt Dogs
episodes.synopsis:
The Detective Agency is framed for the brutal murder of several government officials. Its members are on the run from the Military Police.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: You, A Child of Sin; I, A Child of Sin
episodes.synopsis:
The president of the Detective Agency is arrested, and Kunikida is missing after having blown himself up with a grenade. Meanwhile, Atsushi and Kyouka are on the run, looking for a way to defeat the true mastermind: Fyodor.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: A Dream of Butterflies
episodes.synopsis:
Port Mafia boss Mori wants Yosano to join them in exchange for assisting the Detective Agency through their crisis. Yosano reveals why she would rather not.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: In Lament of My Wingless Body
episodes.synopsis:
Tanizaki, Miyazawa and Yosano head to the site where Yosano is scheduled to be handed off to the Port Mafia.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Jailbreak
episodes.synopsis:
Atsushi and Kyouka convince Mushitaro to escape the vault with them. While making their escape the bank is surrounded by the Special Operations Division being led by Sakaguchi Ango, a member of the Seventh Agency.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Bungo Hound Dogs
episodes.synopsis:
Suspecting that Lucy is cooperating with the terrorist organization known as the Armed Detective Agency, Jouno and Tetchou pay a visit to the cafe at where she works, in hopes of tracking down Atsushi and Kyouka.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
